v:v2:c1: FY2027 full-year total revenue of $400 billion or more
v:v2:c2: FY2027 full-year total revenue of $350 billion or more but below $400 billion
v:v2:c3: FY2027 full-year total revenue of $300 billion or more but below $350 billion; equivalent to more than the annualized FY2026 Q4 revenue of $68 billion, or $272 billion, but below $350 billion

j:v2:0:reasons: Currently rung 3 ($300 billion to $350 billion in FY2027 full-year revenue). The only listed evidence, e1, is management’s statement on FY2026 Q4 revenue and year-over-year growth, not an a fact of realized FY2027 full-year revenue or guidance. Nor can quarterly revenue annualized to $272 billion directly establish FY2027 full-year revenue. The dependent view v3’s rung 3 assessment of FY2027 data center revenue provides a neutral baseline; v1’s capex expectations and v7’s Rubin production ramp plan are only directional positives and are not sufficient to move to rung 1 or 2.

This new fact is not enough to change the FY2027 rung.
